Cinematic 16:9 contemplative golden-hour lifestyle still with modern social-first editorial energy, clean bright filmic grade, slight anamorphic warmth and shallow depth of field. SCARLETT (Image 1) in a black long-sleeve rash vest worn as a swim top and simple flip-flops stands just stopped at the metal safety rail above the beach, forearms settled on the rail, weight leaned forward, muscles still holding the last of her walk, mid-breath as she watches the next set roll through, unfussy no-vanity posture, lived-in coral mouth catching a thin rim of last sun, empty hands, no phone. Wide pale-concrete Bondi promenade running above the sand, the simple metal rail cutting a long horizontal line, open late ocean beyond in deep blue-green with long dark incoming lines of swell, wet sand catching gold, a distant rental-board rack soft in the bokeh, a far jogger reduced to a blur, low beach infrastructure and open sky bleaching toward the horizon. Last warm high-key late-afternoon sun rakes sideways across concrete and steel, gold flare on the rail, clean directional shadows, airy lifted blacks, wind implied in the empty air, true-to-life color with crisp whites and one warm accent against pale concrete and ocean. Three-quarter view from slightly behind her shoulder, eye-level 50mm anamorphic, handheld micro-stillness, background falling off into soft coastal bokeh.
